claims.text: Citing Royal Order A/255 of 26/9/1438 AH, King Salman called for the pledge to Mohammed bin Salman as Crown Prince at Al-Safa Palace in Makkah after Taraweeh prayers that day, Wednesday 26/9/1438 AH.
